title: Vanilla Resource Library
tagline: Guides & tools for casing on Vanilla.
description: The library for vanilla cases, resources, and more! All the extra casing resources you need, compiled into one place.

categoryDescriptions.Guides: All the useful guides for AO roles, the client, and casing.
categoryDescriptions.Casemaking: All the tools and resources you may need to make a case. Includes guides and templates.
categoryDescriptions.Other Case Lists: Case lists, from personal ones of specific casemakers, all the way to other case lists containing a wide variety of cases.
categoryDescriptions.Videos: Multimedia content related to Attorney Online that compiles from tutorials, to channels, playlists, VODs, and meme videos.
categoryDescriptions.Translations: Every case findable that doesn't belong to the English language is here. There can be original cases and translated vanilla cases whose language will be indicated with a flag.
categoryDescriptions.Miscellaneous: All other useful resources including templates, character files, case lists etc.
